en: An illustrated cityscape showing a medieval walled town with red‑tiled roofs, round defensive towers, and several tall church spires rising above the skyline. A particularly high, slender spire dominates the right side, with telegraph or power lines crossing the sky in front. The foreground has green trees and a grassy slope leading up to the stone walls and towers. The image is drawn in a muted, early‑20th‑century illustration style and there is no visible printed text on the front.
